name: Forcera Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Forcera Materials Co. Ltd. specializes in delivering essential consumable components for the semiconductor and electronics industries. Utilizing its advanced technologies, the company provides comprehensive ceramic application solutions. Its core product lineup, crucial for semiconductor fabrication, features materials such as aluminum oxide, quartz, aluminum nitride, and silicon. The firm was founded on September 11, 1997, and maintains its headquarters in Hukou, Taiwan.
